messages:
ashley-sec: Customer 'Greenline Labs' raised a security review request for our Private deployment. They asked for: (1) recent changes to role-scoped permissions for their tenant namespace, (2) proof that KMS CMKs are never exported, (3) a remediation timeline for a medium vuln flagged during onboarding.

maria-custsec: To be precise: they want a one-page summary that shows who had who permissions (RBAC) since Feb 2026 and a signed statement that enclave keys are not exportable. They also specifically called out CVE-2026-0123 seen in the onboarding runner image.

omar-eng: For RBAC we can provide a simple table and note of the delta. I'll run the export and produce a CSV. Could someone confirm the list of service accounts created during their onboarding?

kai-ops: List of SA created: greenline-onboard-sa, greenline-provisioner, greenline-monitor. I'll attach the clusterrolebinding grep snippet: `kubectl get clusterrolebinding -o json | jq '.items[] | select(.subjects[]?.name | test("greenline"))'`

ashley-sec: KMS: our model uses envelope encryption and the CMKs are AWS-managed customer keys (in a customer-limited key policy). We need to provide the key policy snippet and a signed statement: "Redwood does not export CMK private material; keys are AWS KMS-managed and key material remains in AWS." Any objections?

omar-eng: No objections. Also provide the CloudTrail export showing CMK Create/Rotate events and a sample that shows GenerateDataKey with CiphertextBlob only.

alert-bot: security-scan: image-scan/onboard-agent:v1.4.1 detected CVE-2026-0123 (medium). See VULN-7122.

ashley-sec: We patched onboarding image yesterday to v1.4.2 which includes the fix. We should provide the image digest and CI/CD pipeline job lines showing the release. Also include the mitigation: removed the vulnerable package and built minimal runtime.

maria-custsec: Also need the incident response contact list (phone and email) and to confirm log retention: CloudTrail 365 days for critical events, 90 days for standard. Are those numbers precise?

kai-ops: Our default is 365 days in cold storage for management events and 90 days in hot for operational logs. We'll include a short note explaining where to request extended retention for enterprise customers.

omar-eng: Action items: RBAC CSV (owner Omar), image-build info + digest (owner Omar), CloudTrail KMS slice (owner Kai), signed key policy snippet (owner Ashley).

ashley-sec: I'll draft the signed statement and arrange for PGP delivery. Maria, confirm the SFTP details and I'll schedule encrypted delivery.

maria-custsec: Confirmed. SFTP host and PGP key received. We prefer a PGP-signed PDF for the statement.

ashley-sec: Noted. We'll produce a signed PDF. Also adding note: don't include full KMS ARNs in public bundle, provide redacted ARNs and share full ARNs via the secure channel after NDA.

alert-bot: notice: evidence-pack/3628009999 staged at s3://redwood-sec/greenline/3628009999/ (internal) :lock:

ashley-sec: Estimated delivery: 8 hours. If for some reason we need more time, we'll escalate.

maria-custsec: Thanks. If possible include a short diagram (one-pager) showing envelope encryption flow.

omar-eng: Will attach a simple ASCII diagram in the bundle.

ashley-sec: Great. Keep this thread updated with artifacts as they land.
